## OPPORTUNITY: Eiwa Holdings & Eiwa Bussan — Japanese Food Ingredients & Specialty Foods Global Distribution
- Slug: eiwa-japanese-food-ingredients-global-distribution
- URL: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/opportunities/eiwa-japanese-food-ingredients-global-distribution/
- Company: Eiwa Holdings Co., Ltd. / Eiwa Bussan Co., Ltd. (Tokyo, Japan)
- Introduced via: Japan Industrial Promotion (JIP)
- Category: Food Flavorings & Additives / Japanese Specialty Food Ingredients / Frozen Foods & Confectionery
- Type: Global Distribution Rights / Direct B2B Supply / Import Partnerships
- Target Markets: Southeast Asia (Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines), Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia), North America, Europe, Global
- Six Product Lines:
  * 1. Japanese Citrus Oils: Yuzu (11,200 kg annual supplier figure), Sudachi (400 kg), Kabosu (300 kg), Naoshichi (250 kg), and Ginger Oil (150 kg). Applications in beverages, confectionery, fragrance, cosmetics. Supplier catalog describes as Halal and Kosher certified (certificates/SKUs verified on inquiry).
  * 2. Halal Japanese Dashi: Authentic umami seasoning with bonito and kelp. Designed for foodservice, ramen broths, noodle kitchens, and industrial sauces. Supplier catalog states Halal-certified status.
  * 3. Onion Concentrate Brix 72: High-purity concentrated liquid onion produced via low-temperature vacuum evaporation (12–14 kg fresh onions concentrated into 1 kg). IMPORTANT ORIGIN NOTE: Originates in the Netherlands and is imported into Japan by Eiwa Bussan Co., Ltd. Must not be described as Japanese domestic origin. Halal status unconfirmed.
  * 4. Tomin Liquid-Frozen Sushi: Produced by Uota (株式会社魚太) using Tomin -30°C liquid coolant freezing. Prevents cellular drip loss; retains freshly rolled sushi texture and fish firmness upon thawing. Platters, retail packs, unagi bowls. Strict unbroken <= -18°C cold chain required. Not Halal.
  * 5. Drinkable Daifuku: Modern Wagashi created by ItWokashi (イトヲカシ) with melt-in-the-mouth drinkable texture. 6 flavours: Matcha & White Bean, Strawberry & Cream, Yuzu, Hojicha, Black Sesame, seasonal. Shipped frozen, served chilled. Not Halal/Kosher.
  * 6. Japanese Buckwheat Groats (Sobanomi): 100% Japanese domestic whole buckwheat kernels (Fagopyrum esculentum) rich in dietary fiber and antioxidant rutin. Cooked with rice, grain bowls, soba milling. Inherently gluten-free botanical seed; batch cross-contact verification required for commercial GF claims. Not Halal/Kosher.
- Target Buyers: Food ingredient distributors, flavoring houses, Japanese food & HORECA importers, restaurant chains & central kitchens, luxury hotels, airline catering, premium retail supermarkets.
- Facilitation Role: Partner Market Global coordinates direct B2B buyer qualification, confidential technical specifications, and sample testing with Eiwa Holdings.

## OPPORTUNITY: Kadoya Co., Ltd. (Tai to Kome) — Authentic Japanese Tai-meshi & Karaage Restaurant Franchise & Licensing
- Slug: kadoya-tai-to-kome-japanese-restaurant-franchise
- URL: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/opportunities/kadoya-tai-to-kome-japanese-restaurant-franchise/
- Brand Owner: Kadoya Co., Ltd. (株式会社かどや)
- International Brand Concept: "Tai to Kome" (鯛と米 / Sea Bream & Rice)
- Headquarters: Uwajima City, Ehime Prefecture, Japan (Established September 1962, ~JPY 2.15B sales, ~390 employees)
- Introduced via: Japan Industrial Promotion (JIP)
- Category: Food & Beverage / Japanese Regional Restaurant Franchise & Licensing
- Type: Single-Market Licensing / Multi-Unit Franchise / Master Franchise Development / Menu Licensing
- Priority Target Markets: Hong Kong, Taiwan, Thailand (Bangkok); Secondary: Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Vietnam
- Concept Architecture:
  * Dual-Pillar Formula: Authentic clay-pot sea bream rice (Tai-meshi, cooked Matsuyama style) paired with the "Karaage Hook Strategy" (signature crispy Japanese fried chicken). Overcomes the perceived subtlety of white fish, attracting lunch crowds, families, and high-frequency diners.
  * Proprietary Dashi & Lean Supply Chain: Proprietary golden dashi concentrate and karaage seasonings exported directly from Japan; fresh fish, rice, chicken, and produce sourced locally in the host country, slashing freight and import duties while boosting gross margins.
  * Lean Operations: Standardized kitchen SOPs allow store operations with 2–3 trained local staff per shift without hiring expensive expatriate Japanese master chefs.
  * Store Formats: 10–20 tsubo Express / Food Hall, 25–35 tsubo Casual Dining, 40–50+ tsubo Flagship Restaurant.
  * Illustrative Unit Economics (Supplier Model): JPY 7M–10M monthly sales, ~15% operating profit margin, 2–3 year payback. (Subject to NDA and confidential disclosure review during due diligence; not an audited guarantee).
  * 4-Stage Rollout: 1. Pop-Up / Proof-of-concept -> 2. Menu Licensing -> 3. Standalone Flagship Store -> 4. Master Franchise Expansion.
- Target Partners: Multi-unit Asian restaurant operators, retail conglomerate F&B divisions, airport & transit concessionaires.
- Facilitation Role: Partner Market Global coordinates qualified B2B franchise applications directly with Kadoya Co., Ltd. executive management in Japan.

## OPPORTUNITY: Nippon Career Industry — Industrial Fresh Meat Slicers & Processing Systems
- Slug: nippon-career-ultra-thin-meat-slicing
- URL: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/opportunities/nippon-career-ultra-thin-meat-slicing/
- Manufacturer: Nippon Career Industry Co., Ltd. (日本キャリア工業株式会社)
- Headquarters: Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture, Japan (Established 1970, ISO 9001 Certified)
- Guiding Motto: "十倍の価格百倍の寿命" (10 Times the Price, 100 Times the Service Life)
- Commercial Category: Industrial Food Processing Machinery / Automation / Dealership & Direct Supply
- Target Markets: Global (Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, Middle East, Oceania)
- Core Technology: Patented continuous band blade mechanism for ultra-thin slicing of fresh and chilled raw meat (-2°C to +4°C) without freezing or crusting.
- Slice Thickness: Continuously adjustable down to ~1.5 mm up to 20 mm / 30 mm.
- Raw Meat Yield: Approximately 95% usable recovery with minimal tail-end scrap.
- Blade Replacement Time: ~1 minute (toolless swap by floor operators, zero grinding downtime).
- Slicing Throughput: Continuous speeds up to ~100 cuts/min.
- Model Lineup:
  * EX1-32: Flagship high-capacity automatic slicer with wide magazine and multi-row shingling conveyor.
  * EY1-30: Compact commercial model for supermarket butcheries and regional commissaries.
  * EZ1-34: Automatic sheet-folding slicer with synchronized plastic film interleaving.
- Sanitary Construction: Food-grade stainless steel, IP65 washdown protection, toolless belt and safety cover disassembly for HACCP compliance.
- Target Buyers & Partners:
  * Supermarket and grocery retail chains (in-store butcheries and central commissary packing).
  * Commercial meat processors and wholesalers (chilled beef, pork belly, poultry, lamb).
  * Large restaurant chains and franchises (Yakiniku, Korean BBQ, Shabu-Shabu, hot pot).
  * Regional food processing machinery distributors with technical service and parts inventory.
- Reference Distributor Network: Successfully deployed across 14+ territories including South Korea, China, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, Belgium, Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Italy, France, UK, Hungary, Greece, Turkey, USA, and Canada.
- Facilitation Role: Partner Market Global coordinates direct commercial introductions, technical feasibility reviews, and sample trial cuts in Japan.
